judgments.label: uncertain
judgments.rationale: The photo in the fourth thumbnail slide (skull and small figurines in a red-lit showcase), with the visible h3 'Conteúdo Virtual' over it. Its alt 'MUPA Minuto' names the museum's content series, not the picture, so the claim's sentence holds of the capture. Read as an informative illustration, the alt does not convey what the photo shows, so it fails. Against that: the slide promotes the museum's virtual content, of which 'MUPA Minuto' is the series this photo is associated with, and a competent auditor could accept the alternative as conveying the image's purpose in this tab. On the other side, an auditor who treats the thumbnail as decorative would want a null alt instead (F39), a reason the claim states only loosely. Because of that reasonable disagreement the label is uncertain. The live HTML has the same alt.
